voxymap.ui.title: Voxy Map
voxymap.ui.hint: %s close   Scroll zoom   Drag pan   %s center on player
voxymap.config.comment.1: Automatically regenerate the map when the player moves far away or after the initial delay
voxymap.config.comment.2: Refresh once the player moved this many chunks since the last update
voxymap.config.comment.3: Refresh once this many minutes after joining a world (0 disables the initial refresh)
voxymap.config.comment.5: Map resolution: blocks per pixel (1 = sharpest and slowest, 4 = coarse and fast)
voxymap.config.comment.6: Highest Voxy LOD level to merge (0-4). Lower values skip far coarse data
voxymap.config.comment.7: Read the sea level from the world (adapts to terrain mods)
voxymap.config.comment.8: Sea level used when autoSeaLevel is disabled
voxymap.config.comment.10: Default palette: current, gradient, gmt, nautical, gradient-turbo, gradient-soft
voxymap.config.comment.12: Drop contour fragments smaller than this many pixels
voxymap.config.comment.15: Initial zoom when opening the map
voxymap.config.comment.16: Stretch the land colour ramp to the world's actual height range
voxymap.config.comment.17: Blur the water depth to smooth out sea-floor speckles
voxymap.config.comment.18: Water blur radius in map pixels
voxymap.config.comment.20: Remove isolated height outliers on land
voxymap.config.comment.21: Fill small interior data holes with the local median
voxymap.config.comment.23: Show cursor coordinates at the bottom of the screen
voxymap.config.comment.24: Show the control hint in the top-left corner
voxymap.config.comment.25: Offer the teleport entry in the right-click menu
voxymap.config.comment.26: Land only: sea level (green) up to the map's highest point (white); water colours are unchanged
voxymap.config.comment.27: How many contour lines span the land height range (higher = denser)
voxymap.ui.lodWarning.title: LOD data may not be ready yet
voxymap.ui.lodWarning.message: It is recommended to wait for LOD generation before refreshing the map. Refresh now?
voxymap.ui.overworldOnly: Only overworld LOD maps are supported for now
voxymap.config.desc.autoRefreshMode: gentle: slow background refresh only while standing still; fast: refresh while the map is open; off: only the manual button.
voxymap.config.desc.gentleBudgetMsPer10s: CPU time the gentle background refresh may use per 10 seconds.
voxymap.config.desc.gentleIdleSeconds: How long the player must stand still before gentle refresh starts.
voxymap.config.desc.incrementalMaxChange: Above this percentage of changed sections a full rebuild is used instead of an incremental merge.
voxymap.config.desc.incrementalRefresh: Only read sections that changed since the last refresh and update the affected part of the map. Falls back to a full rebuild when needed.
voxymap.config.desc.refreshDistanceChunk: Radius around the player covered by auto refresh.
voxymap.config.desc.initialRefreshDelayM: Wait before the first automatic refresh of a new world.
voxymap.config.desc.mapScale: Blocks represented by one map pixel.
voxymap.config.desc.maxLodLevel: Highest-detail level read from Voxy data.
voxymap.config.desc.cacheKeepCount: Number of map caches to keep; the oldest are removed beyond this.
voxymap.config.desc.autoSeaLevel: Take the sea level from the world automatically.
voxymap.config.desc.seaLevelOverride: Manual sea level, used when auto detection is off.
voxymap.config.desc.defaultStyle: Map style used for new worlds.
voxymap.config.desc.defaultZoom: Initial zoom when the map opens.
voxymap.config.desc.drawContours: Draw contour lines on the terrain.
voxymap.config.desc.minContourArea: Ignore contour fragments smaller than this.
voxymap.config.desc.drawHillshade: Shade terrain with a light direction to show relief.
voxymap.config.desc.adaptiveColorRamp: Stretch the ramp to this world's actual height range.
voxymap.config.desc.landMaxRamp: Use the map's highest point as the top of the land ramp.
voxymap.config.desc.waterBlurRadius: Sampling radius of the water blur.
voxymap.config.desc.fillHoles: Fill small holes inside the terrain.
voxymap.config.desc.biomeLabelMinArea: Biomes smaller than this are not labelled.
voxymap.config.desc.biomeLabelBackground: Add a background to biome labels for readability.
voxymap.config.desc.arrowStyle: Texture used for the 2D player marker.
voxymap.config.desc.showRenderDistance: Outline the render distance on the map.
voxymap.config.desc.releaseTexturesOnClo: Free map textures when the map closes to save VRAM.
voxymap.config.desc.skipWorldRender: Do not render the world behind the open map.
voxymap.config.desc.showCoordinates: Show the hovered position and biome.
voxymap.config.desc.showHint: Show the key hints at the top of the screen.
voxymap.config.desc.teleportEnabled: Teleport to the target from the right-click menu.
voxymap.config.desc.debugEnabled: Enable the debug panel (toggle with Q).
voxymap.config.desc.debugRefreshChat: Print a compact refresh report to the chat (mode, trigger, changed sections, dirty area, timings).
voxymap.config.desc.debugRefreshVerbose: Also print scan / merge / colour / texture / cache stage timings to the chat.
voxymap.config.desc.rememberZoom: Restore the previous zoom per world.
voxymap.config.desc.renderScale3d: 3D image resolution as a percentage of the physical window size.
voxymap.config.desc.verticalScale3d: Vertical stretch factor applied to terrain height.
voxymap.config.desc.fov3d: Vertical field of view of the perspective projection.
voxymap.config.desc.lodDebugColors3d: Tint terrain by LOD layer (near red, mid green, far blue).
voxymap.config.desc.lodRebuildDistance: Rebuild the LOD mesh after the camera moves this far.
voxymap.config.desc.lodZoomRebuildPct: Rebuild the LOD mesh when the camera distance changes by this much.
voxymap.config.desc.lodNearRadius: Spherical radius of the high-detail layer.
voxymap.config.desc.lodMidRadius: Spherical radius of the medium-detail layer.
voxymap.config.desc.antialias3d: Smooths edges once the camera stops moving.
voxymap.config.desc.lodStepNear: Map pixels per near vertex; lower is denser.
voxymap.config.desc.remember3dView: Reopen the map in the same 2D/3D mode.
voxymap.ui.oversize.title: Memory warning
voxymap.ui.oversize.line1: This map is about %s x 100M pixels, above the %s x 100M limit.
voxymap.ui.oversize.line2: Loading it may run out of memory and crash the game.
voxymap.ui.oversize.line3: The limit can be changed in config/voxymap-client.json (maxMapPixels).
voxymap.ui.oversize.noSafe: Even the coarsest 1:8 map would exceed the memory limit.
voxymap.ui.outOfMemory: Out of memory: this map is too large for the game's heap. Lower the map scale (1:3 or coarser) or raise the game memory.
voxymap.config.desc.maxMapPixels: Warn before building a map larger than this pixel count.
voxymap.config.desc.playerMarkerHeight3d: How far above the terrain the player arrow floats.
voxymap.config.desc.playerMarkerScale3d: Arrow size multiplier; it also scales with camera distance.
voxymap.config.desc.autoHideContours3d: Hide contour lines while the 3D view is open.
voxymap.config.desc.biomeLabel3dRange: Only biome labels within this horizontal distance are shown in 3D.
